_comment: HT160S WhiteList sort-mode sample. Deploy as D:\HT160S_BCB\HT160S_WhiteList\WhiteList.json (fixed folder + fixed file name; the folder is always <program root>\HT160S_WhiteList). In By WhiteList mode this file is the authoritative 2D->Bin source (loaded at Lot Start, replacing the WebAPI pull). Only 2D codes listed here are sorted, each to its listed HBin (routed through the static Bin->Auto recipe table, same as Normal mode); any scanned 2D code NOT in this list is sent silently to the Error bin. Customer schema (KYEC-WhiteList-Interface-Spec 3.2): root QRCodeIDHis[] -> lot { LOTID, KYECLotID, Substage, ProductCode, ICInfo[] } -> IC { QRCodeID, HBin }. LOTID MUST match the lot declared by the host (SET_LOT_INFO/LOTSTART) or entered by the operator, else Start is blocked. KYECLotID is MANDATORY on every lot - one lot without it invalidates the WHOLE file and Lot Start is refused. HBin is a STRING. 2D codes are byte-exact (case-sensitive) and must be unique across the file. The _comment key is ignored by the parser.
